prompt:
Production modular house INTERIOR kit for Midlife Survivors. Reference1 establishes native32px texture and prop clusters, reference2 exact slight top-down THREE-QUARTER office interior camera. This is an ASSET STUDY, not a painted room. Arrange SIX COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS of evenly spaced square cells, 30 cells total, no labels/grid. Rows0-1 are small terrain/wall modules; rows2-4 isolated complete FURNITURE items. Source items later packed into a512x384 atlas with exact native rectangles.
Row0 left-to-right SIX FULL SQUARE textures, filling each cell: warm oak hardwood A, warm oak hardwood B, kitchen checker tile A, kitchen checker tile B, lavender kid's room carpet A, lavender carpet B. No outlines on floor textures; edges designed to repeat seamlessly.
Row1 SIX modules left-to-right: hallway runner rug A on oak floor, runner rug B on oak floor; cream interior wall strip with sage baseboard HORIZONTAL; same VERTICAL; same CORNER; DOORWAY GAP. Rugs fill square tiles; wall pieces isolated on magenta with a clear visible gap in doorway. Repeating edges.
Row2 SIX living-room objects, each isolated on magenta: saggy SAGE COUCH (native96x48), RECLINER with dad-shaped dent and no person (48x48), low COFFEE TABLE with remotes and mug ring (64x32), TV on LOW STAND (64x48), overflowing LAUNDRY BASKET (32x32), standing FLOOR LAMP (32x64).
Row3 SIX kitchen objects: COUNTER RUN WITH SINK (128x48); FRIDGE with tiny kid drawings/magnets no writing (48x64); STOVE (48x48); ROUND TABLE WITH FOUR CHAIRS (96x96); OPEN JUNK DRAWER (32x32); STACK OF MAIL AND BLANK BILLS (32x32).
Row4 SIX kid room objects: TWIN BED dinosaur blanket generic cartoon dinosaur silhouette (64x96); DESK BURIED IN BLANK HOMEWORK SHEETS (64x48); TOY CHEST spilling generic studded bricks (48x48); BEANBAG (48x48); BOOKSHELF (64x48); tiny GLOW STARS on a ceiling-patch decal (32x32). No added characters anywhere.
Use modest ground-plane depth, consistent scale vs56x60 heroes; avoid isometric45degree view. Chunky16-bit pixel art, one-pixel navy silhouette outlines, 2-3 hue-shifted tones, upper-left light. Lived-in/messy but readable. Palette ONLY #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #EF9347 #C45C4B #BFA8CF #F1B5BF. Furniture backgrounds flat exact opaque #FF00FF, no floor plates or cast shadow. Neutral white balance, no sepia/golden haze/film tint. No words, text, letters, numbers, logos or brands. Every object whole and separated from neighboring cell.
nativeProcess: Proportional native sampling, exact twelve-color palette mapping, grid packing and validation. House states share all pixels outside doorway. Floor edges cleaned for compatible tiling.
